LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.Assist.RemoveSewageDesc: Mark polluted cells to be shoveled clean. Each cell takes 120 ticks and leaves one barrel of fecal sludge.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.Assist.DrainTankDesc: Mark water storage to be drained. The water is dumped on the ground and becomes pollution.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.Assist.KickOverDesc: Spill this barrel of fecal sludge on the ground.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.Assist.RemovePlumbingDesc: Designate plumbing buildings (anything with a pipe) for deconstruction.
